- Aromatic carbons (Ar-H): 115-130 ppm

- 137.56, 137.56 ppm: These are aromatic carbons (Ar-C range: 130-150 ppm) - 2 carbons
- 131.90, 131.90 ppm: These are aromatic carbons (Ar-C range: 130-150 ppm) - 2 carbons
- 130.00, 130.00, 130.00, 130.00 ppm: These are aromatic carbons (Ar-H/Ar-C range) - 4 carbons
- 128.40, 128.40, 128.40, 128.40 ppm: These are aromatic carbons (Ar-H range: 115-130 ppm) - 4 carbons
